description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for note requests, encapsulating data for creating or updating notes, with validation and schema annotations.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: A DTO class representing the request payload for creating or updating a note, including title and content fields with validation annotations.

methods.description: Setter for the 'title' field, returns the current object for method chaining.
